Package com.egradx.auth.account

Class EgradxAuthCleanup

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.account.EgradxAuthCleanup
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.context.Lifecycle, org.springframework.context.Phased, org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
public class EgradxAuthCleanup extends Object implements org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
Deletes what can no longer be used: refresh tokens past their expiry, password-reset links and email-change codes. Without it those tables only ever grow. Invitations are kept, as a record of who was invited.

Runs on a thread of its own rather than via @Scheduled, for the reason egradx-notification's dispatcher gives: @Scheduled would need the application to enable scheduling, or this library to enable it for the whole application. Several instances may run it at once — a delete of what has expired is the same however often it runs.
